claim: For the Ye–He sine-controlled flow at the published chaotic parameters \(\varepsilon_2=33/10\) and \(\sigma_2=47/10\), namely \(\dot x_1=4.195x_1-4.295x_2+1.295x_3\), \(\dot x_2=3.1x_1-3.2x_2-6.1x_3\), and \(\dot x_3=-7.605x_1+7.605x_2-1.905x_3+(33/10)\sin((47/10)x_2)\), the complete real equilibrium set contains exactly 53 points, all hyperbolic and unstable. Writing \(t=(47/10)x_2\), the equilibria are in one-to-one correspondence with the zeros of \(t+(231898/2735)\sin t=0\): there are exactly two positive zeros in each interval \(((2k-1)\pi,2k\pi)\) for \(k=1,\ldots,13\), their negatives, and \(t=0\). For every equilibrium the characteristic polynomial is \(p_q(\lambda)=\lambda^3+(91/100)\lambda^2+(61q/10+27117/500)\lambda+54153/10000-(7401/250)q\), where \(q=(1551/100)\cos t\). The 26 equilibria corresponding to the left-half zeros \(t\in((2k-1)\pi,(2k-1/2)\pi)\) and their negatives have unstable dimension two; the 26 right-half equilibria and the origin have unstable dimension one. Thus the source's three-scroll chaotic parameter set is organized by an exact interlaced census of 53 saddle equilibria rather than merely the few sample equilibria listed in the article.
integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the published vector field using exact rational elimination, convexity of the reduced scalar equilibrium equation, and a cubic Routh count. A bundled dependency-free checker replays the rational identities and numerical root bracketing. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equilibrium census and unstable-index split are specific to the printed Ye–He vector field at epsilon2=3.3 and sigma2=4.7. The result does not establish scroll count, basin structure, or the source's horseshoe claim, and it does not classify how the census changes throughout parameter space.
title: Exact equilibrium census and unstable-index split for a sine-controlled multiscroll flow
